title: ProjektManga source manifest
description: src/<source_key>/manifest.json — everything a source declares by hand. Fields the build can derive (entry_url, icon_url, version_code, api_version, isNSFW, bundle hash) are deliberately absent. build.mjs enforces this schema and a few rules JSON Schema cannot express; see docs/repository-format.md.

source_key.description: Stable identity. Must equal the source's directory name — the bundle is published as dist/<source_key>.js. Never reuse a key for a different site.

name.description: Display name shown in the install listing.

lang.description: BCP-47 code (en, pt-BR, zh-Hant), or "all" for a source that is language-agnostic.

version.description: major.minor.patch, each part 0-999. Bump whenever the source's code changes; the build derives version_code from it.

description.description: One line for the install listing.

base_url.description: Where the source's requests go. For an API-backed source this is the API origin, not the site.

homepage.description: Where a human should be sent to see the site, when that differs from base_url. Defaults to base_url.

allowed_hosts.description: Every host the source may reach, including hosts reached only via a redirect. Bare lowercase hostnames: no scheme, port, path or wildcard. Matching is exact or by suffix, so "example.com" also permits "cdn.example.com". The build rejects a list that does not cover base_url.

content_rating.description: safe = no adult content; mixed = general catalogue that also carries adult titles; nsfw = adult site. Only "nsfw" sets isNSFW in the index.

rate_limit_ms.description: Minimum milliseconds between this source's requests, enforced by the app outside the sandbox. Declare the same value the source limits itself to internally: the internal one keeps the source polite, this one is what actually holds. Defaults to 1000 when absent.

requires_browser_fetch.description: Request the elevated __browserFetch capability, which asks the app to load a URL in a real browser with its anti-detection stack. The runner injects that global only for sources that set this, and the app warns the user before installing one. Set it only for a site that plain fetch genuinely cannot read, such as one behind an active Cloudflare challenge.

referer.description: Referer the app sends when proxying this source's images. Defaults to homepage, then base_url; set it only when a site rejects those.

draft.description: Build the source but keep it out of index.json. Requires draft_reason.

draft_reason.description: Why this source is held back, and what would have to change to publish it.
